title: Python: the four in-design blind-sample misses (attrs 16/23 annotated converter receiver; luigi 68 cls-inherited; luigi 37 self to module function)
description: From GCLI-174 scored run (DEC-303 (a110)). These are in-design misses, not the Q2 self.attr class and not the gate: attrs drawIndex 16 and 23 (a receiver converter annotated converter: Converter in src/attr/_make.py, the call missed), luigi drawIndex 68 (a classmethod reached through cls where the definition is inherited through the MRO), and luigi drawIndex 37 (self.check_complete where check_complete is a module-level function, not a class method). Each shape must first be reproduced on a FIXTURE, never on the spent sample; the spent sample code is not read for design (DEC-303 (a36) item 8; (a109) item 2). Nothing is built for self.attr (Q2) or for the gate; the operator choice dec-0y1zsed is pending. No hold; the start is permitted, fixtures only.

acceptanceCriteria.text: A fixture reproduces the annotated-receiver shape (a parameter annotated with a class, a call through it) as a miss at the frozen head, and the fix resolves it; the fixture is the ground truth, not the spent sample.

A fixture reproduces the cls-inherited shape (a classmethod reached through cls where the definition is inherited) as a miss at the frozen head, and the fix resolves it; the fixture is the ground truth.

A fixture reproduces the self-to-module-function shape (self.<name> where <name> is a module-level function, not a class method) as a miss at the frozen head, and the fix resolves it; the fixture is the ground truth.
No spent blind-sample checkout is read to design or prove the fix, and nothing is built for self.attr (Q2) or the gate while dec-0y1zsed is pending.

plan: 1. Reproduce all three shapes on fixtures at the frozen analyzer: the annotated parameter's bare call bins nameNotBound; self./cls. calls to a class-body alias bin receiverNeedsInference; a classmethod() wrapper on a base misses through the inherited MRO.
2. Resolve a bare call on a single-binding annotated parameter (or annotated assignment) through the annotation class __call__, as the constructed-local path already does.

3. Resolve self./cls./Cls. calls whose name is a class-body assignment to an in-repo function — a direct alias or an unshadowed classmethod()/staticmethod() wrapper — through the MRO; every other class-scope binding keeps today's fail-closed refusal.
4. Pin the fixtures and their bins in test/python-calls.test.ts; run typecheck, lint, format:check, test.
5. Commit, open one PR into dev, report the number and head to the leader.
implementationNotes: REPRODUCED, THEN FIXED, ON FIXTURES (DEC-303 (a110) item 3) at 2026-11-28T03:58:20Z by date -u. Pre-change bins at analyzer 6021949e: an annotated parameter called through (attrs 16/23 shape) bins nameNotBound; self.<class-attribute alias of a module function> (luigi 37 shape) and cls.<helper assigned classmethod(helper) in an inherited base> (luigi 68 shape) bin receiverNeedsInference. Post-change all three resolve: the annotated call to the class __call__ (same dispatch as x = C(); x()), and both class-attribute shapes to the module function through the MRO. Design: a class-body assignment is read only when its last binding's right-hand side is an in-repo function directly or an unshadowed classmethod()/staticmethod() wrapper around one; lambdas, literals, constructions, conditional assignments and attribute RHS keep the fail-closed refusal. This narrows rules 36/43: a wrapper that binds the SAME def now resolves instead of refusing, and the two tests that pinned the old outcome carry that note plus negative controls (helper = None and a literal still refuse). Fixtures only; no sample checkout read; nothing built for Q2 or the gate.
